rootCauseAnalysis.repeatedObservation: Target Runtime audit failed only when a counter-window candidate was rejected before Pareto selection and had no materialized Proof.
rootCauseAnalysis.whyNotCandidateEnumeration: The candidate remained in the frozen audit vector set and was rejected by the current counter opportunity before Pareto selection; no candidate was removed from preparation.
rootCauseAnalysis.whyNotKernelValue: The failure occurred after target vectors and proofs were produced. The missing value was only a witness for a candidate outside the active counter pool.
rootCauseAnalysis.whyNotReport: The transaction failed during Runtime audit before Report projection and Seal.
rootCauseAnalysis.whyNotHiddenInformation: The failing validation branch reads only DecisionAudit rejectionCode and Pareto witness fields; no world or belief field is consulted.
rootCauseAnalysis.counterexampleCoverage: The same target case completed three and five rounds after the Runtime guard was corrected; all other eleven B01 cases were rerun under the same source hash.

semanticDecision.rule: A candidate rejected by target-provider eligibility does not require a Pareto witness when it has no required Proof. Non-rejected candidates still require a valid NON_DOMINATED, DOMINATED, or HARD_EXCLUDED witness; required Proof remains mandatory.
semanticDecision.reason: A rejected candidate is outside the active Pareto comparison set, so a dominator in that set is undefined. Treating the absence as a causal Fatal contradicts DecisionAuditV2 required-subset Proof semantics.

changeImpact.changedBranch: target DecisionAudit validation: no Proof branch
changeImpact.affectedCondition: row.rejectionCode is non-empty and candidateValueProof is absent

changedResponsibilityChain: Runtime required Proof and witness validation

resultAnalysis.nextExitCondition: Read current-hash PLAYER facts first, then classify observations without prefilled behavior conclusions.
